authorities.root_pyproject_toml: canonical for ruff, black, mypy(repo-scope), pytest(repo-scope), mutmut(inherits backend rootdir)
authorities.backend_pyproject_toml: canonical for pytest(backend rootdir), mypy(strict), mutmut(config), hypothesis

drift_detection: config_hashes in environment fingerprint; any change invalidates cached evidence
conflict_resolution: single_authority_policy: root pyproject.toml is Python authority; backend/pyproject.toml is backend-scoped authority
